mentions.name: Domio
mentions.description: Zillow-style real estate site for Moldova that scrapes property listings from the internet, mostly classifieds sites, and places them on a map.
mentions.problem: There isn't really a Zillow-like website in Moldova — property listings exist mostly on classifieds sites.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://domio.md/ - zillow for moldova.

same idea - there isn't really a zillow like website in moldova - mostly classifieds sites. so I figured why not - gonna scrape the internet and put them on the map.
mentions.author: amotinga
